clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Starweave rests in Auberdine as a night elf ancestral spirit. She shares ancient wisdom with pilgrims along Darkshore’s coast.

In Auberdine, Elder Starweave appears as an ethereal shade among the coastal dwellings. The Cenarion Circle and the peoples of Kalimdor honor her as an ancestor. Travelers pass through the port on their way inland or across the sea, but those who pause before her receive an ancestral blessing. She speaks of the stars, whose paths in this age differ from those of old, and sees them as beacons of hope and fortitude for generations to come.
